claims: The Orion capsule is NASA’s crewed spacecraft for the Artemis program.
The Orion capsule is designed to carry four astronauts to the Moon and into deep space.
The Orion capsule serves as a vehicle for future Mars missions.
The Orion capsule features a 5,000°F heat shield.
The Orion capsule is launched by the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The Orion capsule features a 330 cubic foot crew module.
The Orion capsule's crew module provides 57% more space than Apollo.
The Orion capsule has capacity for four crew members for up to 21 days.
The Launch Abort System (LAS), the Crew Module (CM), and the European-built Service Module (ESM).
The Orion capsule includes sleeping bags.
The Orion capsule includes a galley.
The Orion capsule includes a hygiene bay (toilet).
The Orion capsule is designed for re-entry at approximately 24,700 mph from the Moon.
The Orion capsule's heat shield protects the crew.
Water landing is the primary method of recovery for the Orion capsule.
The Orion capsule is built with an aluminum-lithium alloy.
The Orion capsule acts as the primary habitat for crews during transit in the Artemis lunar missions.
